description: Prices a configuration with the website's price list and gives, for each production speed (urgente, standard, economica), the estimated ship date: the day the order leaves the warehouse and is handed to the courier, not the delivery date. Prices VAT excluded as the product page shows them (total_excl_vat, struck-through list_total_excl_vat) and VAT included (total); promotions with their end date. Call get_product first: product_id, variant_id, options and allowed quantities come from there. Options left out take the default value of the product page (default: true in the response); those hidden by the rules are listed in ignored_option_ids. Guest prices (no loyalty discounts), excluding shipping, packaging and payment-method fees (e.g. cash on delivery), which the website adds at checkout.

graphic_service.description: 0 none, 1 operator check of the print file, 2 basic graphic design, 3 advanced graphic design; priced per subject as in metadata.configurator.graphic_services. Omit it when that list is empty.

quantity.description: Number of pieces, among those allowed in metadata.configurator.

selections.description: Chosen values: attribute_option_id and value_id from metadata.configurator.attributes.

subjects.description: Number of different artworks sharing the quantity, up to metadata.configurator.max_subjects.

width.description: Width in cm, for made-to-measure products.

name: price_configuration
title: Price a configuration
